activity.notes: Albert Kalonji led the de facto autonomous South Kasai regime created in August 1960. ATLAS retains South Kasai as a distinct short-lived de facto political community while noting that it claimed autonomy/federal status rather than universally recognized sovereign independence.

sources.title: Why Congo Persists — QEH Working Paper Series
sources.citation_text: The Oxford working paper describes Kalonji's August 1960 proclamation and organization of autonomous rule in South Kasai, which functioned until 1962.

sources.title: South Kasai
sources.citation_text: The compiled chronology records South Kasai's proclamation on 9 August 1960 and Kalonji's appointment as president.
